scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build:test: PORT=${PORT:-3001} BASE_PATH=${BASE_PATH:-/} API_PROXY_TARGET=${API_PROXY_TARGET:-http://127.0.0.1:3001} corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/denok-bat run build && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.build: corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run typecheck:libs && corepack pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
